meals.title: Your breakfast sandwich, rebuilt
meals.desc: Whole-grain English muffin, 1 egg + 2 whites, turkey sausage patty, tomato, dijon. The bagel was 300+ calories of white flour and the American cheese was pure saturated fat — this keeps everything you actually taste.

method: Brown the sausage patty in a nonstick pan, 2–3 minutes a side; set aside.
Beat the egg and whites, pour into the same pan, and fold into a rough square as they set.
Toast the muffin. Spread with dijon, stack sausage, egg, and tomato. Pepper and hot sauce to finish.

meals.title: Breakfast "fried rice," rebuilt
meals.desc: Half brown rice, half cauliflower rice (you won't notice), 1 egg + 2 whites, peas, carrots, scallions, 2 tsp sesame oil, low-sodium soy. Same flavor, half the starch, a third of the oil.

ingredients: ¾ cup cooked brown rice, cold from the fridge
¾ cup cauliflower rice (frozen is fine)
¼ cup frozen peas and carrots
2 tsp low-sodium soy sauce, white pepper
method: Heat 1 tsp sesame oil in a hot pan, scramble the eggs until just set, remove.
Add the second tsp of oil, then the cauliflower rice, peas and carrots — stir-fry 2 minutes until dry.
Add the brown rice, press flat, let it sit 60 seconds to crisp, then toss.
Return the eggs, add soy, white pepper, and scallions. Off the heat, one more toss.

meals.title: Overnight oats
meals.desc: ½ cup oats, 1 tbsp chia, ¾ cup 2% Greek yogurt, berries, 8 walnut halves, cinnamon. Assemble the night before. The single best LDL breakfast there is — beta-glucan plus omega-3s.

method: Stir oats, chia, yogurt, milk, and cinnamon in a jar. Lid on, fridge overnight.
In the morning, top with berries and walnuts. Keeps 3 days, so make several at once.

meals.title: Savory oats with a soft egg
meals.desc: Oats cooked in chicken broth, topped with a jammy egg, scallions, chili crisp (1 tsp), sesame. Congee energy, five minutes. For the guy who'd rather not eat "dessert oatmeal."

method: Simmer oats in the broth 4–5 minutes, stirring, until creamy like congee.
Meanwhile, lower the egg into boiling water for 7 minutes, then into cold water; peel and halve.
Bowl the oats, set the jammy egg on top, finish with scallion, chili crisp, and sesame.

meals.title: Huevos with black beans
meals.desc: 1 egg + 2 whites scrambled, ½ cup black beans, 2 corn tortillas, salsa, ⅛ avocado, cilantro. Beans at breakfast is a cheat code for the daily soluble-fiber target.

ingredients: ½ cup canned black beans, drained, warmed with a pinch of cumin
method: Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable and spotted.
Soft-scramble the egg and whites in the same pan with a little oil spray.
Load tortillas with beans and eggs, top with salsa, avocado, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime.

meals.title: Smoked salmon toast
meals.desc: 2 slices dense whole-grain toast, ¼ avocado mashed, 2 oz smoked salmon, tomato, capers, squeeze of lemon. Omega-3s before 9am.

ingredients: Lemon, black pepper, red onion optional
method: Toast the bread well. Mash the avocado straight onto it with a fork.
Drape the salmon over, add tomato, capers, and onion if using. Lemon and pepper over the top.

meals.title: Greek yogurt power bowl
meals.desc: 1 cup 2% Greek yogurt, ½ cup berries, ¼ cup low-sugar granola, 1 tbsp sliced almonds, drizzle of honey. The fast option for rushed mornings.

method: Yogurt in a bowl, everything else on top. Ninety seconds, done.

meals.title: Gym-morning smoothie
meals.desc: Whey protein scoop, ¼ cup oats, ½ banana, frozen berries, handful of spinach, 1 tbsp peanut butter, water or unsweetened almond milk. Drinkable on the way to the gym.

ingredients: 10–12 oz water or unsweetened almond milk, ice
method: Blend the oats first to a powder, then add everything else and blend until smooth.

meals.title: Big chicken & chickpea salad
meals.desc: 6 oz grilled chicken, ½ cup chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, red onion, feta (2 tbsp), olive-oil vinaigrette, over romaine with a small whole-grain roll.

ingredients: ½ cucumber, chopped; 1 tomato, chopped; ¼ red onion, sliced
Dressing: 1 tbsp olive oil, 2 tsp red wine vinegar, ½ tsp dijon, oregano
method: Shake the dressing in a jar.
Toss everything except the chicken and feta with the dressing, then top with chicken and feta. Roll on the side.

meals.title: Chicken burrito bowl
meals.desc: ¾ cup brown rice, ½ cup black beans, 5 oz chicken, fajita peppers and onions, salsa, 2 tbsp guacamole, no cheese, no sour cream. Better than the restaurant version and 400 calories lighter.

ingredients: ½ cup canned black beans, warmed
1 cup peppers and onions, sautéed hot with cumin and chili powder
method: Layer rice, beans, chicken, and fajita vegetables in a bowl.
Top with salsa, guacamole, cilantro, and lime. No cheese, no sour cream — you won't miss them here.

meals.title: Tuna & white bean salad
meals.desc: 1 can tuna in olive oil (drained), ¾ cup cannellini beans, celery, red onion, parsley, lemon, over greens with whole-grain crackers. Zero cooking, omega-3s plus soluble fiber in one bowl.

ingredients: 1 can (5 oz) tuna in olive oil, drained
¾ cup canned cannellini beans, rinsed
1 celery stalk, sliced; ¼ red onion, thin
1 tbsp olive oil, juice of ½ lemon
method: Fold tuna, beans, celery, onion, and parsley with the oil and lemon; season with pepper.
Pile onto the greens, crackers on the side.

meals.title: Asian chopped chicken salad
meals.desc: 5 oz chicken, shredded cabbage and carrots, ¾ cup edamame, mandarin segments, scallions, peanut-lime dressing (1½ tbsp peanut butter base), crushed peanuts.

ingredients: 2 cups shredded cabbage + 1 shredded carrot (or slaw mix)
Dressing: 1½ tbsp peanut butter, juice of 1 lime, 2 tsp soy, 1 tsp chili crisp, water to thin
method: Whisk the dressing until pourable.
Toss cabbage, carrot, edamame, and chicken with most of it; top with mandarin, scallion, peanuts, and the rest.

meals.title: Turkey-avocado sandwich + soup
meals.desc: Whole-grain bread, 4 oz turkey, ¼ avocado instead of mayo, mustard, lettuce, tomato, plus a cup of minestrone or vegetable soup. The deli lunch, corrected.

ingredients: ¼ avocado, mashed (this is the mayo)
method: Spread one slice with mashed avocado, the other with mustard; build the sandwich.
Heat the soup. That's lunch.

meals.title: Lentil or black bean soup, upgraded
meals.desc: 2 cups hearty lentil or black bean soup (batch-cook Sunday), topped with Greek yogurt and hot sauce, side salad with vinaigrette, 1 slice whole-grain bread. The single biggest soluble-fiber meal in this guide.

recipe.serves: Batch — about 5 servings of 2 cups. Same recipe as Batch Cook Rotation B.
ingredients: 1 onion, 2 carrots, 2 celery stalks, 4 garlic cloves — all chopped
2 cups green or brown lentils (or 3 cans black beans)
1 tsp cumin, ½ tsp smoked paprika
Per bowl: dollop of Greek yogurt, hot sauce, 1 slice whole-grain bread, side salad
method: Sweat the vegetables in the oil 5 minutes; add garlic and spices for 1 more.
Add lentils, tomatoes, and broth. Simmer 40–45 minutes until tender.
Stir in the spinach to wilt, season, and portion. Serve each bowl with yogurt, hot sauce, bread, and a side salad.

meals.title: Chicken pita with hummus
meals.desc: Whole-wheat pita, 5 oz chicken, 3 tbsp hummus, cucumber-tomato salad with olive oil and lemon, pickled onions.

ingredients: ½ cucumber + 1 tomato, chopped, with 1 tsp olive oil and lemon
Pickled red onions if you have them
method: Spread the hummus inside the pita, stuff with chicken and the cucumber-tomato salad.

meals.title: Last night's dinner, boxed
meals.desc: Cook one extra portion at dinner and lunch handles itself. Every dinner below is sized so a full leftover portion fits the lunch slot.

meals.title: Chicken-vegetable stir fry
meals.desc: 6 oz chicken, 3 cups broccoli/peppers/snap peas, garlic-ginger sauce, 2 tsp oil in a hot wok, ¾ cup brown rice. The workhorse — swap in any protein and vegetable you have.

recipe.serves: Serves 2 — box the second portion for lunch
ingredients: 6 cups vegetables: broccoli, bell pepper, snap peas
Sauce: 3 tbsp low-sodium soy, 3 garlic cloves minced, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 1 tsp cornstarch, ¼ cup broth or water, 1 tsp sesame oil
1½ cups cooked brown rice (¾ cup per plate)
method: Stir the sauce together. Get the pan or wok smoking hot.
Sear the chicken in half the oil until just cooked, 3–4 minutes; remove.
Stir-fry the vegetables in the rest of the oil 3 minutes — crisp, not soft.
Chicken back in, sauce in, toss 60 seconds until glossy. Serve over the rice.

meals.title: Teriyaki salmon & edamame
meals.desc: 6 oz salmon glazed with reduced-sugar teriyaki, ¾ cup brown rice, steamed edamame, cucumber salad with rice vinegar. One of your two weekly fish dinners.

ingredients: 1 cup edamame in the pod, steamed
½ cucumber, sliced, with 1 tbsp rice vinegar and sesame seeds
method: Toss the cucumber with rice vinegar and a pinch of salt; set aside.
Pan-sear the salmon skin-side down 4 minutes, flip for 2–3, brushing with teriyaki in the last minute (broiler works too).
Plate with rice, edamame, and the cucumber salad.

meals.title: Shrimp fried rice, rebuilt
meals.desc: Half brown rice, half cauliflower rice, 6 oz shrimp, 1 egg, peas, carrots, scallions, 1 tbsp oil total, soy and white pepper. Your favorite, engineered to fit the plan.

ingredients: ¾ cup cooked brown rice, cold
⅓ cup frozen peas and carrots
method: Hot pan, half the oil: sear the shrimp 1–2 minutes a side until pink; remove.
Rest of the oil: scramble the egg, then add cauliflower rice and peas-carrots, 2 minutes.
Add brown rice, press and crisp 1 minute, then toss with soy and white pepper.
Shrimp and scallions back in, one last toss.

meals.title: Chicken fajitas
meals.desc: 6 oz chicken, charred peppers and onions, 3 corn tortillas, 2 tbsp guacamole, salsa, lime. Skip the cheese mound and sour cream — the char and lime do the work.

ingredients: 12 oz chicken breast, sliced into strips
Fajita spice: 1 tsp each cumin and chili powder, ½ tsp smoked paprika, ½ tsp garlic powder, salt
method: Toss the chicken in half the spice, the vegetables in the rest.
Screaming-hot cast iron: char the vegetables 4–5 minutes, remove; then the chicken 4–5 minutes.
Warm the tortillas. Build fajitas with guacamole, salsa, lime, and cilantro — the char does the work the cheese used to.

meals.title: Turkey & black bean chili
meals.desc: 93% lean ground turkey, two kinds of beans, fire-roasted tomatoes, real chili spices, topped with avocado and Greek yogurt. Batch-cook it — it's three dinners and two lunches.

recipe.serves: Batch — 5 servings. Same recipe as Batch Cook Rotation A.
ingredients: 1 large onion, chopped; 4 garlic cloves, minced
2 tbsp chili powder, 1 tbsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp oregano
2 cans black beans + 1 can kidney beans, drained
Per bowl: ⅛ avocado and a dollop of Greek yogurt
method: Brown the turkey in a big pot, breaking it up; add onion until soft, then garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add beans, tomatoes, and broth. Simmer low, lid on, 45–60 minutes; it needs almost nothing from you.
Finish with lime. Serve topped with avocado and Greek yogurt. Freezes for 3 months.

meals.title: Fish tacos
meals.desc: 6 oz grilled cod or mahi with cumin and lime, 3 corn tortillas, cabbage slaw, yogurt-lime crema, pico de gallo. Fish dinner number two, disguised as taco night.

ingredients: ½ tsp each cumin and chili powder, salt, juice of ½ lime
1 cup cabbage slaw with a splash of vinegar
Crema: 3 tbsp Greek yogurt, lime juice, pinch of salt
method: Rub the fish with the spices and lime; grill or pan-sear 3 minutes a side, then flake.
Stir the crema together. Warm the tortillas.
Build: slaw, fish, crema, pico, cilantro.

meals.title: Sheet-pan salmon & potatoes
meals.desc: 6 oz salmon, baby potatoes, broccoli, all roasted in olive oil with lemon and garlic. One pan, 25 minutes, nothing to think about.

ingredients: 3 garlic cloves, smashed; ½ lemon; salt, pepper, oregano
method: Oven to 425°. Potatoes and garlic with half the oil on a sheet pan, in for 15 minutes.
Push them over; add broccoli and the salmon with the rest of the oil. Back in for 12 minutes.
Squeeze the lemon over everything, straight from the pan.

meals.title: Whole-wheat pasta bolognese
meals.desc: 1½ cups whole-wheat pasta, sauce built on 93% lean turkey or half-lean-beef, plenty of tomato, splash of red wine in the pot (not the glass), big side salad. Pasta night survives — the portion and the noodle changed, not the ritual.

ingredients: 1 onion + 1 carrot, finely chopped; 4 garlic cloves
1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes + 2 tbsp tomato paste
Splash of red wine (in the pot, not the glass), 1 tsp oregano, chili flake
6 oz dry whole-wheat pasta (1½ cups cooked per person)
Big salad with olive-oil vinaigrette on the side
method: Soften onion and carrot in the oil; add garlic, then the meat, browning well.
Tomato paste for 1 minute, wine to deglaze, then crushed tomatoes and herbs. Simmer 25+ minutes.
Cook the pasta, toss with the sauce, and serve with the salad doing half the plate's volume.

meals.title: Shrimp & white bean skillet
meals.desc: 6 oz shrimp, cannellini beans, cherry tomatoes, spinach, garlic, olive oil, chili flake, with a slice of grilled whole-grain bread to mop it up. 20 minutes.

method: Warm the garlic and chili flake in the oil until fragrant; add tomatoes until they slump, 3–4 minutes.
Add beans to heat through, then the shrimp, 2 minutes a side.
Wilt the spinach in, season, and mop it all up with the grilled bread.

meals.title: Grilled pork tenderloin plate
meals.desc: 6 oz pork tenderloin (as lean as chicken breast), roasted sweet potato, green beans with slivered almonds. Comfort food that needs no apology.

ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin (about 1 lb) — 6 oz cooked per plate
Rub: 1 tsp smoked paprika, ½ tsp garlic powder, salt, pepper
2 cups green beans per person, 1 tbsp slivered almonds
method: Rub the pork. Grill or roast at 425° for 18–22 minutes to 145° inside; rest 5 minutes before slicing.
Roast the sweet potatoes alongside (prick, 45 minutes) or microwave 6–8 minutes.
Blister the green beans in olive oil, finish with almonds and salt.

meals.title: Turkey burger & oven fries
meals.desc: 6 oz turkey burger on a whole-grain bun with all the fixings, potato wedges tossed in olive oil and roasted hot, vinegar slaw on the side.

ingredients: 6 oz 93% lean ground turkey, seasoned with salt, pepper, garlic powder, worcestershire
1 medium potato, cut into wedges, 2 tsp olive oil
Vinegar slaw: cabbage, splash of cider vinegar, pinch of sugar and salt
method: Wedges tossed in oil and salt, 425° oven for 30–35 minutes, flipping once.
Form the patty with a dimple in the middle; pan-sear 4–5 minutes a side to 165°.
Build the burger with all the fixings; slaw and fries alongside.

meals.title: Steak night (once a week)
meals.desc: 5 oz sirloin or flank, baked potato with Greek yogurt and chives instead of butter and sour cream, asparagus. Red meat isn't banned — it's a weekly event with a lean cut.

method: Bake the potato at 425° for 50 minutes (or microwave 8, oven 10 to finish the skin).
Season the steak well; sear in a ripping-hot pan 3–4 minutes a side for medium-rare. Rest 5 minutes.
Roast or pan-blister the asparagus. Split the potato and load with Greek yogurt and chives — tangier than sour cream, three times the protein.

meals.title: Apple + peanut butter
meals.desc: One apple, 1 tbsp natural peanut butter. Apple pectin is soluble fiber.

meals.title: The daily nuts
meals.desc: ¼ cup almonds or walnuts, measured, not from the bag. A daily handful of nuts is one of the best-proven LDL movers there is.

meals.title: Greek yogurt + berries
meals.desc: ¾ cup 2% Greek yogurt with a handful of berries. Also the answer when a dessert craving hits at 9pm.

meals.title: Hummus + vegetables
meals.desc: ¼ cup hummus with carrots, cucumber, and bell pepper strips.

meals.title: Edamame with flaky salt
meals.desc: 1 cup in-shell edamame, steamed from frozen in 4 minutes. Soy protein has its own modest LDL-lowering effect.

ingredients: 1 cup frozen edamame in the pod
method: Steam or microwave from frozen, 3–4 minutes. Salt while hot.

meals.title: Popcorn, air-popped
meals.desc: 4 cups air-popped, olive oil spray, salt or Tajín. Volume for when you want to eat a lot of something.

method: Air-pop (or brown-paper-bag it in the microwave, folded shut, ~2 minutes). Spray lightly, season, shake.

meals.title: Dark chocolate + almonds
meals.desc: 2 squares of 85% dark chocolate with 6 almonds. The planned sweet — see the Alcohol & Sweets tab for how this fits the dessert strategy.

meals.title: Cottage cheese + pineapple
meals.desc: ¾ cup low-fat cottage cheese with ⅓ cup pineapple. Old school, high protein, works.

meals.title: Crispy parmesan carrot fries
meals.desc: Carrot sticks tossed in smoked paprika, oregano, and onion powder, coated in parmesan, roasted hot at 450° until crispy. A serving is an eighth of a 7-carrot batch with a little peri peri for dipping. The parmesan carries real saturated fat, so on carrot-fries day make this your cheese for the day.

recipe.serves: Makes 8 servings — one serving is an eighth of the batch
ingredients: Olive oil spray + 1–2 tsp olive oil
1 tsp each smoked paprika, dried oregano, onion powder
Peri peri or hot sauce for dipping
method: Oven to 450°, lined tray.
Peel and cut the carrots into fries, ½–1cm thick. Coat lightly with the oil spray.
Toss with the spices, then coat each fry in the parmesan.
Single layer on the tray; bake until crisp and golden, flipping once, about 20–25 minutes. Dip and go.

meals.title: Greek beef wraps, roasted garlic feta sauce
meals.desc: 1 lb of 93% lean ground beef with oregano and cumin, split across 3 servings: whole-wheat pita, tomato, cucumber, red onion, lettuce, and a sauce of feta, Greek yogurt, and a whole roasted garlic bulb, with a side Greek salad. The feta is the day's cheese, and this counts as the week's red-meat night unless you swap in ground turkey.

ingredients: 1 lb 93% lean ground beef (or ground turkey to keep red meat for steak night)
1 tsp oregano, ½ tsp cumin, ½ tsp garlic powder, salt, pepper
Sauce: ½ cup crumbled feta, ½ cup 2% Greek yogurt, 1 whole roasted garlic bulb, 1 tbsp lemon juice
1 cup diced tomato, ½ cup cucumber, ¼ cup red onion, 1 cup shredded lettuce
Side Greek salad: tomato, cucumber, olives, 1 tbsp olive-oil vinaigrette per person
method: Roast the garlic: top off a bulb, drizzle of oil, wrapped at 400° for 40 minutes until golden and soft (do it ahead, or alongside a sheet-pan night).
Brown the beef with the spices, breaking it up well.
Squeeze the roasted cloves into the feta, yogurt, and lemon; mash smooth.
Load each pita with beef, vegetables, and a generous drizzle of sauce. Greek salad on the side.

meals.title: High-protein chocolate oat bars
meals.desc: Oats, vanilla protein powder, peanut butter powder, a little real peanut butter and honey, pressed into a tin and topped with dark chocolate. One bar is an eighth of the batch — make them your planned sweet: batch on Sunday, one bar covers the dessert itch for 160 calories.

ingredients: Topping: 60g dark chocolate chips melted with 5g coconut oil
method: Mix oats, protein powder, PB2, peanut butter, honey, water, and salt into a stiff dough.
Press firmly into a lined loaf tin.
Pour over the melted chocolate, spread thin, chill 1 hour, slice into 8.
